items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 24:1
items.html: The soul of Adam HaRishon is truly from phase four, that is, the Malchut of the first restriction that was restricted; and his body is from the aspect of the point of this world. And this is only from the aspect of the source. For Adam HaRishon was born in the world of correction, in which phase four — which is the quality of judgment — had already been sweetened in the quality of mercy, which is phase two, Bina. And this is the secret of "and God created the man, dust from the ground," for mere dust is the point of this world, which is called dust; but "dust from the ground" indicates that it was already sweetened in Bina, which is called ground, the land of Edom — that is, the Malchut included in Bina. And he was refined so much at the time of his creation, that he had nothing from this world, for even the aspect of his body was of the VAK of Yetzirah, standing in the place of the six upper [Sefirot] of the world of Beriah. And in the second and third discernments of the eve of Shabbat he was refined even more, as is known. (Part 1, Page 955, subheading "and it was explained").
